title: ISHAAN
logline: The character reveal. The jacket goes on, and the boy the audience will follow for the next 26 minutes is formally introduced.
grade: Warm key, cool bounce, and — for the first time — the jacket's RED and BLUE accents are the only saturated colours in frame. Grade the scene to protect them.

narration.hi: वैसे, अभी तक मैंने अपने बारे में कुछ बताया ही नहीं।
narration.en: Actually, I haven't told you anything about myself yet.

narration.hi: क्लास टेन का स्टूडेंट। स्कूल, दोस्त, होमवर्क और परीक्षाएँ... बस यही मेरी दुनिया थी।
narration.en: A class-ten student. School, friends, homework, exams… that was my entire world.

narration.hi: कम से कम, उस दिन तक तो नहीं।
narration.en: At least, not until that day.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.55 m, over his shoulder into the mirror — we see the REFLECTION, not him
shots.move: Static. Fade up already inside the shot — no scene-setting.
shots.action: The black jacket is already on his shoulders; he turns the collar up, then flattens it, then settles it.
shots.expr: Focused on the task; jaw set; eyes on his own reflection.
shots.env: Mirror above a small dresser, a comb, a school ID card, a tube of hair product.
shots.light: Hard lateral sun from frame-right catching the crimson inner lining as the collar moves.
shots.vfx: Red lining edge bloom only when it faces the light — one flicker, no constant glow.
shots.cont: JACKET LOCK JKT-BLR-01: matte black technical bomber, crimson inner lining, thin red piping on shoulder seam and chest pocket zip, two cobalt-blue geometric accents (collar tab + right forearm), ribbed cuffs, no hood, no logo.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.58 m, 40 cm, framed on the eyes in the mirror
shots.action: He looks at himself, blinks once, and pushes his fringe out of his left eye — it falls straight back.
shots.expr: Self-assessment without vanity: a small frown, then acceptance.
shots.env: Mirror glass with a faint smudge at frame-left; the room behind him is soft bokeh.
shots.light: Two catchlights, warm; dark brown iris with amber flecks at 4 o'clock.
shots.vfx: None. Eyes must be pristine — no over-sharpening.
shots.vo: Line 2 at 07:18 — 'My name is Ishaan' lands here, on his own reflection, not on a wide shot.
shots.cont: Pupil size identical to S01-04. Iris fleck position locked (CONT-EYE-01).

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.30 m, three-quarter front, window behind camera-left
shots.move: Slow 20° arc around him, clockwise, keeping the window at his back-left.
shots.action: Turns from the mirror, rolls his shoulders once to settle the jacket, and tugs the ribbed cuff.
shots.env: Bedroom, school bag on the bed, jacket fully visible for the first time.
shots.light: Key from frame-left, cool bounce from the wall — the jacket reads as black, never grey.
shots.vo: Line 3 begins at 07:30 and rides the arc.
shots.cont: Full-body identity check: 5'7", lean athletic build, white school shirt under the jacket, navy trousers, black canvas shoes.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.10 m, low on the right forearm, angled up
shots.action: His thumb traces the small blue geometric accent on the sleeve — a private, unconscious habit.
shots.env: Sleeve detail against the defocused bed.
shots.light: Raking side light so the blue accent catches one specular highlight; red piping glows faintly.
shots.vfx: None. Resist adding energy here — the jacket is ordinary in Episode 1.
shots.vo: Silence. The habit is a private ritual — do not narrate it.
shots.cont: CONT-HABIT-01: he touches this accent again in S12-04 (foreshadow) and S13-04.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.50 m, from the corridor looking into the doorway
shots.move: Static. He crosses the frame left to right and exits.
shots.action: Full-body silhouette in the doorway; Maa passes behind him carrying laundry; he ducks slightly to let her through.
shots.env: Doorway framing the lit bedroom; the corridor in shadow.
shots.light: Backlit doorway — his outline is crisp, jacket breaks the light at the shoulders.
shots.vo: Line 3 ends at 07:52; the remainder of the shot is silent.
shots.cont: This doorway framing is the parent of S02-07 and S13-06 — the 'threshold' motif (MOTIF-01).

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.40 m, at the stair head, looking back at his bedroom door
shots.move: Static. He turns his head back once, then goes.
shots.action: Sling the bag over one shoulder, one last look at his room, then down the stairs out of frame.
shots.expr: A flicker of something unnameable — the last time he looks at this room as an ordinary room.
shots.env: Stair head, bedroom door behind him, morning light on the wall.
shots.light: Warm; the room behind him is slightly overexposed, as if already becoming a memory.
shots.vfx: Very faint halation on the door frame.
shots.vo: Line 4 at 08:36 — 'not until that day' — then hard cut to black for 12 frames, then Scene 5.
shots.cont: Bag: dark grey backpack with one red zip pull (P-03). Keep consistent to S10.
